description:
Returns all property keys for the Forge app.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only Forge apps can make this request. This API can only be accessed using **[asApp()](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/apis-reference/fetch-api-product.requestjira/#method-signature)** requests from Forge.

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

errorMessages: Access to this resource must be authenticated as an app.

403.description: Returned if the request isn't made directly by an app or if it's an impersonated request.
